summary: The Verge's deals roundup tracks discounts on Apple's M-series MacBook Air, MacBook Pro and Mac Mini models as of late October 2023, just as the new M3 generation launched. It advises against older Intel-based Macs and notes that Apple's refurbished store offers a one-year warranty and savings of 15 to 20 percent. Specific retailer prices and discount amounts are given for each model, from the $749.99 M1 Air to a $2,499 M1 Max Pro.
one_line: A late-October 2023 roundup of current discounts on M1, M2 and new M3 MacBook Air, MacBook Pro and Mac Mini models.
key_facts: Apple's MacBook lineup runs from the 13-inch MacBook Air from 2020 at $999 up to the latest 16-inch MacBook Pro starting at $2,499.
Current Mac models are often discounted by as much as $400, and Apple's refurbished store gives a one-year warranty and generally 15 to 20 percent off new prices.
The Verge does not recommend buying older Intel-based Macs, which it says are completely outclassed by newer models.
The base M1 MacBook Air (8GB RAM, 256GB storage) normally costs $999 but is $749.99 ($250 off) at Amazon and Best Buy, matching its lowest price.
Apple announced at WWDC that the 13-inch M2 MacBook Air now starts at $1,099 instead of $1,199; it sells for $899 ($200 off) at B&H Photo.
The 15-inch M2 MacBook Air starts at $1,299 and is $300 off at $999 at Amazon or Best Buy; the 512GB model is $300 off at $1,199 at Best Buy.
Apple unveiled M3 Macs at its 'Scary Fast' event the night before Halloween, including a 14-inch M3 MacBook Pro replacing the 13-inch M2 model, which ends Touch Bar Macs.
The 14-inch M3 MacBook Pro with 512GB is $1,399 ($200 off) at Amazon, Best Buy and B&H Photo; it starts with 8GB of RAM and lacks the third Thunderbolt port of the M3 Pro and M3 Max models.
The 14-inch and 16-inch M3 Pro/Max MacBook Pros start at $1,999 and $2,499 with 18GB of base RAM; the 16-inch review unit Apple sent cost $7,199.
The base 14-inch M3 Pro MacBook Pro is $1,749 ($250 off) at B&H Photo, and the base 16-inch M3 Pro is $2,249 ($250 off) at Amazon and B&H Photo.
The base 14-inch M2 Pro MacBook Pro (512GB, 16GB RAM) is $1,629 ($370 off) at Amazon, while the 1TB model is $1,999 ($500 off) at B&H Photo.
A 2021 16-inch M1 Max MacBook Pro with 64GB RAM and 2TB storage is $2,499 ($1,800 off) at B&H Photo; it once sold for $4,299.
The base M2 Mac Mini ($599 list) is a new all-time low of $479 ($120 off) at Amazon and B&H Photo, and the M2 Pro model ($1,299 list) is $1,149 ($150 off) at B&H Photo.
